name: SS Poland
builder: Furness, Withy & Co., West Hartlepool, England
summary: A British-built passenger and cargo steamship whose long career unfolded under several names and operating arrangements. Constructed in 1897, she was launched as Victoria for the Wilson’s & Furness-Leyland Line; She became Manitou in 1898 and entered service for the Atlantic Transport Line before later employment by the Red Star Line.
